title: Follow a training step through failure and recovery
description: Switch scenarios to see how rank health, collective membership, checkpoint publication, and scheduler decisions determine whether training can continue safely.

nodes.label: Input shards
nodes.detail: Assigns deterministic examples or token ranges to data-parallel ranks and records enough progress to avoid silent skips or duplicates after recovery.

nodes.label: Worker group
nodes.detail: Runs forward and backward work for each data, tensor, pipeline, context, or expert partition in the launched process groups.

nodes.label: Collective fabric
nodes.detail: Executes all-reduce, all-gather, reduce-scatter, and point-to-point operations. Every participating rank must enter compatible operations in the same order.

nodes.label: Global step state
nodes.detail: Represents model, optimizer, scheduler, scaler, and progress state after a coherent distributed update has completed.

nodes.label: Checkpoint store
nodes.detail: Stores immutable shards and exposes a checkpoint only after its manifest, expected files, versions, and integrity checks are complete.

nodes.label: Job scheduler
nodes.detail: Detects failed ranks, tears down invalid process groups, allocates replacements, and launches a restore from the last committed checkpoint.

scenarios.label: Healthy step
scenarios.summary: All ranks consume their assigned data, enter the expected collectives, apply one coherent update, and publish a background checkpoint.
scenarios.result: Training may advance because the synchronization contract completed. The checkpoint becomes a recovery point only after all shards and its manifest are committed.

scenarios.label: Slow rank
scenarios.summary: One worker receives data late, so peers reach the next collective first and wait for the straggler.
scenarios.result: The step remains correct but its tail latency rises to the slowest required rank. Compare per-rank input and collective timelines before adding more devices.

scenarios.label: Rank lost
scenarios.summary: A rank disappears before the collective finishes, invalidating the current process group and partial step.
scenarios.result: Do not apply the partial update. Tear down the failed group, allocate a complete replacement group, and resume model, optimizer, progress, and sampler state from the last committed checkpoint.

scenarios.label: Incomplete checkpoint
scenarios.summary: Training wrote some state shards, but the storage path failed before the checkpoint manifest was committed.
scenarios.result: The incomplete version must remain undiscoverable. Retain and restore the previous validated manifest, then investigate storage capacity, atomic publication, and checkpoint-age risk.
